title: How To Win At The Sport Of Business

questions.q: What did Cuban do before returning to his passion for sports?
a: Solved a problem people needed solved
Raised venture capital for a startup
questions.why: Lesson 1 says he built MicroSolutions around a need rather than chasing his passion first.

questions.q: Why does the summary warn against borrowing money?
a: Investors can take control and push you out
Interest rates are usually too high
Banks rarely lend to new businesses
questions.why: Lesson 2 says selling part of your business gives investors control over you and your decisions.

questions.q: What is the benefit of slow, organic growth?
a: It is stable and keeps you in control
questions.why: Lesson 2 says organic growth is less flashy but more stable, profitable and independent.

People who agree with every idea
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the first hires make or break a company, so they must share your drive.

questions.q: Which habit shows how motivated Cuban remained?
questions.why: Lesson 3 notes that even as a billionaire he still replied to customer complaints himself.
